responsibility: Contains the PDP-11 RTL machine description: the target’s instruction set model, expanders, splitters, peepholes, register and condition-code constants, iterators, attributes, and asm output templates. It includes the backend’s predicates and constraints files, defines unspec codes and CC substitutions, provides prologue/epilogue expanders, and describes how arithmetic, shifts, branches, floating-point operations, multiword moves, division/modulo, byte swaps, and other RTL operations are recognized or lowered into concrete PDP-11 instructions, including instruction lengths and costs used by later backend stages.
same_name_distinction: Is the RTL machine-description file for PDP-11 instruction selection and recognition, with define_insn/define_expand patterns, predicates/includes, attributes, and peepholes. Unlike pdp11.cc, which provides C++ helper logic and target hooks, and pdp11.h, which sets target macros and ABI constants, this file is the declarative instruction-set model consumed by GCC’s MD generators; unlike pdp11.opt, it does not define command-line switches.
